name: Wrath of Mynah
storyline: Wrath of Mynah is a turn-based RPG adventure game that follows the gripping story of The Great Hanyem War. Hundreds of years after Mynah Smith arrived on Hanyem, you play as Pike Gilder, a petty thief who wants to make a difference in the everlasting fight against the tyrannical Indigallo Federation as they lose their grip over their territories. Join forces with a plethora of unique party members, such as Tusk, Liz Fureon, Deven Proditor, Rosie, Nova Acri, and Val Fortis! Collect items, armor and weapons! Uncover the deep history and lore of Hanyem and the human, felibrawno, and gisharen people. Eventually you will be prepared for the ultimate battle against the mysterious General Zed Aurum and King Mynah Smith IX!
